text_simplified: A young girl grows up loving goodness when she sees it practiced at home and becomes accustomed to it—such as keeping a small charity box to remove stinginess from her soul, and hastening to voluntary prayers like the Duha prayer and serving religion. Parents should also open the door of dialogue and discussion with their daughter, listen to her attentively, and then guide her gently in light of what they hear from her, as this strengthens her bond with her family and helps her refine herself.
